name: search_repo
description:
List Git repositories in a namespace for a supported Git provider, optionally narrowed by query. Get namespaceId from git_namespaces. If provider or namespace is omitted, they are derived from the authenticated user.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/integrations/search-repo --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

host.description: The custom Git host if using a custom Git provider, like GitHub Enterprise Server

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
